entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello Diana. I need to return an item from a recent order.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF78331.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with them?
They just aren't working out for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but after every ride, I end up with painful blisters on my heels. The fit just seems off.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing you discomfort. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see here the order was delivered 53 days ago.

Okay, I've just reviewed the policy. For standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. So you are well within that period. I can definitely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, that's great news. Thank you. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging these up and sending them back, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next order?

I understand the request, Alex. While I can't provide an additional discount code, I can confirm that we will cover the return shipping and you will receive a full refund for the item's purchase price. We want to make sure you get your money back for a product that didn't work for you.
Alright, I suppose that's fair enough. A full refund is the main thing. I appreciate you checking on that for me.
Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
